metadata.title: Military Disposition Public Coverage Entity Index
metadata.coverage_policy: UN member states + UN observer states + curated commonly tracked disputed/partially recognized entities.

entities.name: Abkhazia
entities.included_reason: Commonly tracked de facto authority with public security-force data.
entities.sovereignty_context: Breakaway region internationally treated by most states as part of Georgia.
entities.notes: Do not infer Russian disposition beyond public high-level descriptions.

entities.name: Kosovo
entities.included_reason: Commonly tracked partially recognized state with public security-force data.
entities.sovereignty_context: Declared independence from Serbia; recognized by many states but not a UN member.
entities.notes: Use XKX as a user-assigned code, not an ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code.

entities.name: Northern Cyprus
entities.included_reason: Commonly tracked de facto authority with public security-force data.
entities.sovereignty_context: Self-declared state recognized only by Turkiye; internationally treated as part of Cyprus.
entities.notes: Separate Turkish military presence assumptions from local forces.

entities.name: Somaliland
entities.included_reason: Commonly tracked de facto authority with public security-force data.
entities.sovereignty_context: Self-declared state internationally treated as part of Somalia.
entities.notes: No ISO 3166-1 state code; use stable local entity_id.

entities.name: South Ossetia
entities.included_reason: Commonly tracked de facto authority with public security-force data.
entities.sovereignty_context: Breakaway region internationally treated by most states as part of Georgia.
entities.notes: Do not infer Russian disposition beyond public high-level descriptions.

entities.name: Taiwan
entities.included_reason: Commonly tracked self-governing entity with extensive public defense data.
entities.sovereignty_context: Self-governing; claimed by the People's Republic of China; recognition is limited.
entities.notes: Use neutral naming and explicit status fields in simulations.

entities.name: Transnistria
entities.included_reason: Commonly tracked de facto authority with public security-force data.
entities.sovereignty_context: Breakaway region internationally treated by most states as part of Moldova.
entities.notes: Keep Russian peacekeeping/operational assumptions separate and source-bound.

entities.name: Western Sahara / Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic
entities.sovereignty_context: Territory disputed between Morocco and the Polisario Front/SADR.
entities.notes: Keep territorial-control assumptions separate from entity identity.
